name: Lonely a while after a day away, Boop asks to be petted, and a stroke answers
case: The person comes back after more than a day away, opens claude, and doesn't touch or talk to Boop, which turns lonely. Once it has been lonely a while, an idle check-in has it ask to be petted: "pet me?", with its two answers. The person strokes it, which answers the question, and Boop is lonely no more: happy or comfy.
why: asks.md's [pet lonely touch]: offered once lonely has lasted Asks.lonelyMs, its option says it's for a lonely moment; a touch answers it (the board's ev ask, touch); mood/lonely.md: a stroke ends it at once
